title: Fundamental Structure — Static and Dynamic Aspects
centralThesis: A thing is represented not by a fixed symbol alone but by an invariant system of transformations whose recursive structure generates distinction, reflexion, duration and temporal order.

continuityObjects.meaning: operation transforming one member into another

staticBeats: Introduce x because repetition of o cannot distinguish.
Priority, not location, differentiates two things.
o and x define the invariant transformation between them.
oo and ox secure precedence without location.
Four symbols support three independent pairings.
Derive the three mutually independent interchanges.
Superpose zero and three interchange operations.
A tetrad of tetrads repeats the same structure.
Any member transformation permutes the set without changing it.
Immediate and reflexive structure share one form.
Particular/general and reflexive hierarchies extend indefinitely.
dynamicBeats: Unchange and change are one invariant transformation.
Column interchange repeats while the whole remains unchanged.
Two rates of change do not produce true duration.
Infinite moments converge by geometric acceleration.
Eternal, regular and accelerating levels coexist.
The hierarchy extends both ways with no universal present.
o vanishes, x becomes the new o; the system is not reversible.
This has weight 2/3 and that 1/3; lower orders sum to unity.
Nested squares alternate between depth hierarchy and temporal corridor.
All exist in the present as over-, fully-, and under-determined.
One this remains invariant while three thats vary.
The chair remains chair through shifting relative determinations.
Weights 3:2:1 become 9:4:1, then 81:16:1 until one operation dominates.
Intention, action and choice require the continuation.
